h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ozhukarai

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Ozhukarai

items.pText: Ozhukarai is the largely residential municipality that wraps around Puducherry town on its western side. Its neighbourhood parks, school grounds and housing layouts are used by families of every age, often all at the same time in the evening. A municipal park here has to serve toddlers, older children and adults who come to walk or exercise.

FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground and fitness equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,110 km away. It travels to Puducherry by road, and our installation team or a local dealer puts it in. This coast gets most of its rain in the northeast monsoon, from October to December, and the sea air carries salt inland. Share the size of your park or ground and a few photos. We will suggest equipment for each age group and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Planning a park for every age group

c: In a public park, separate the play equipment into zones. Toddlers need low pieces such as
close to seating. Older children need climbers, swings or a multi play system a short distance away, so the two groups do not collide.
Adults are best served by an outdoor gym along the walking track. Our
page covers that side. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic suit the salt air. Raise the base slightly so water drains away during the northeast monsoon.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,110 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can you plan a full park with play and gym equipment in Ozhukarai?
items.a: Yes. We can place both on one layout drawing, with separate zones for toddlers, older children and adults, and seating between them.

items.q: Does the coastal air affect playground equipment in Puducherry?
items.a: Salt air is hard on untreated steel. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist it well, and rinsing the equipment with fresh water now and then helps.
Our own installation team or a dealer in the region, using a self-standing or grouted method depending on the ground.
